name: Multi-asset contract COLA override per asset (keying bug)
expected: On ONE renewal quote covering >=2 assets that share the same Activated override contract 00003473 (COLA_Override_Percent__c=4%), each asset applies its own Contract Override -> COLA_Uplift_Percent__c=4, COLA_Source__c='Contract Override', UnitPrice=6306.30 (=6063.75*1.04) on every line.
actual: Adversarial re-verify on current V21 (v67.0): (1) The keying bug in AssetContractQueryHelper is REAL at the Apex code level -- live probe F05_PROBE on queryAssetContracts({RVDN,RVDO,RVDP,RVDQ}) returns rowsReturned=1 (only RVDQ survives), MISSING={RVDN,RVDO,RVDP}; buildResults Map<Id,Id> keyed by ContractId last-write-wins. BUT this is the COLAUpliftHandler.handleBeforeInsert Apex trigger + helper, NOT V21 steps 26-28. (2) The bug is LATENT: it only drops a needed override when one QLI-insert covers >=2 assets on the same activated override contract. NO such quote exists in the org -- every renewal/amendment quote sourcing RVDN/RVDO/RVDP/RVDQ renews exactly ONE asset, so the collapse never drops a needed row in real data (matches SC-3354 peer-review item C-2, marked 'No (latent)'). (3) V21 itself does NOT produce the wrong number: Force-reprice (v67.0) of control quote 0Q0WC00000355yD0AQ renewing RVDN (an asset in the executor's 'missing set') re-measures UnitPrice=6306.30, COLA_Uplift=4, COLA_Source='Contract Override' -- correct and preserved through V21. (4) The executor's cited 'defective' QLI 0QLWC000003aVMw4AM on quote 0Q0WC0000035Jt80AE is MIS-ATTRIBUTED: its SourceAssetId is 02iWC000007UVX0YAO, which is NOT one of the contract 00003473 ACR assets at all -- UVX0 belongs to contract 00003480 (COLA_Override_Percent__c=null). Its 7.85% CMDT Lookup result (UnitPrice 6539.75) is CORRECT (no contract override exists to apply), confirmed by fresh V21 reprice.

notes: Adversarial verdict overturns executor FAIL/PROCEDURE-DEFECT(V21). The keying bug is genuine Apex code but: (a) it lives in the COLAUpliftHandler trigger + AssetContractQueryHelper, not in V21 steps 26-28; (b) V21 reprice PRESERVES the correct Contract Override (proven on control RVDN line, post-reprice 6306.30/4%/Contract Override); (c) the executor's cited defective line is an unrelated single-asset renewal (asset UVX0, contract 00003480 with null override) whose 7.85% CMDT result is CORRECT, not a defect; (d) no record on the org reproduces the multi-asset-single-quote precondition, so the branch is latent (SC-3354 C-2 'No (latent)'). Cannot smoke-test as a V21 defect: not in V21, and no valid F-05 fixture reaches the collapse path on current org data. Verdict=BLOCKED, rootCause=TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT (mis-cited record + latent non-V21 code path with no triggering data).
verdict_reason: BLOCKED, not FAIL. Skepticism gate fails on two of four required proofs: (1) The disputed wrong number was NOT produced by V21 -- a fresh V21 Force-reprice (v67.0) of the control quote renewing RVDN (an asset the executor lists as 'missing/collapsed') re-measures and keeps the CORRECT Contract Override 4%/6306.30. V21 does not corrupt COLA; the value is stamped by the COLAUpliftHandler before-insert Apex trigger upstream. (2) The executor's cited defective evidence does not reach the intended F-05 branch on valid inputs: quote 0Q0WC0000035Jt80AE renews asset UVX0 whose contract (00003480) has NO COLA override, so 7.85% CMDT is the correct answer for that line; it is not a multi-asset-override line at all. (3) The genuine AssetContractQueryHelper keying collapse is real (probe rowsReturned=1) but LATENT: no quote in the org renews >=2 same-contract override assets in a single insert, so the bug never drops a needed override in real data (SC-3354 C-2 marked 'No (latent)'). A defect that (a) is in an Apex trigger not V21, (b) has its only cited failing line mis-attributed to an unrelated correct result, and (c) is unreachable by any current org data is not a confirmable V21 PROCEDURE-DEFECT. Real latent Apex cleanup belongs to SC-3354 P2 backlog, not the V21 validation defect list.
